scale.provenance: Median of the 10 axes implied by the five ink-measured room rects below. Spot-checked against the ink: BEDROOM 1 (left)'s top wall is y=5-14 and its bottom wall y=206-210, giving faces 15 and 205 against the stored rect [16, 206]. The 17% spread (13.97-16.36) is the widest of any fixture and is the drawing, not the detector: the four bedrooms agree within 4% and LIVING ROOM sits 12% above them. That is the case a single-room calibration cannot survive and a multi-room consensus can.

rooms.note: Was [178, 15, 312, 160] with minIou lowered to 0.5, which permitted a 42% error indefinitely. Both edges were wrong. Left: 178 sits inside the closet strip, which BEDROOM 1's own truth (right edge 170) already excludes from that room, so it belongs to neither rect; the partition between closet and bedroom is the wall run at x=200-210. Right: 312 is the bed outline (7px, 63% column coverage), not a wall; the room's right wall is the run at x=354-372 (19px, 100% coverage) shared with the stairwell. The corrected box also matches the label: 151px / 10.667ft = 14.2 px/ft against 14.3-14.5 for the neighbouring bedrooms, where the old box implied 12.6.
